create_graph: create a gtn Graph object to represent a finite state transducer for pattern recognition
add_node_to_graph: add a start or final node to a gtn Graph with is_start and is_final flags
add_arc_to_graph: add an arc between two nodes in a gtn Graph with a symbol label
draw_graph_to_pdf: draw a gtn Graph to a PDF file with arc and node symbol mappings
union_graphs: union multiple gtn Graph objects into a single combined graph
